match all
  subject contains "invoice"
  not from.address has domain "bank.example"
  not from.address has domain "receipts.shop.example"
suggestions.why: The judge said no to all 7 messages from these 2 sending domains in the last 30 days, and yes to none. Leaving them out before the judge is asked saves about 7 judge calls a month.
Every one of the 2 messages you kept scored 0.86 or more, and the 2 you dismissed scored 0.73 at most. A bar of 0.79, between them, keeps the first and leaves out the second.
